title: Shape-example seed — not a deployable pack
deployability: never — this pack exists to make _SCHEMA.md concrete while D4's 'which jurisdiction' half is open. It mixes jurisdiction tags on purpose (one us row, one uk row, so the shape visibly does not pick a side), and no loader may accept it as a deployment pack. The v1 pack is authored under PACKS.md's protocol after Joseph answers.
owner: P6 (injected) — never P5 — for the fact path; P7's injected detector set (catalogue 08's discipline) for the gate projections
consumer: value rows: the caller-supplied value lookup injected at P6 fact-resolver construction, word-boundary matched, a ranked candidate entering the section-3.7 ranking and never a fact alone. gate projections: the caller builds catalogue 08's four R5 slots from rows' gate_slots declarations and injects them into P7's classification pass. No module under src/ may hold any of this at module level.
